'''Alex Tennet The Emperor's Hand''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Alex Tennet]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds124.htm The Emperor's Hand], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027092257/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds124.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
